summary: Pisgah National Forest weighed a steel lookout for Big Chestnut Knob in 1922; a USGS map published 1995 shows a lookout tower on Chestnut Mountain; no source describes it now.

events.note: Pisgah National Forest was considering lookouts; a steel tower with an enclosed lookout room was described as likely on Big Chestnut Knob, between Caldwell and Burke counties.
Pastmaps describes a USGS topographic map of the area, portraying 1993 and published 1995, as showing a Lookout Tower on Chestnut Mtn.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The forest listing gives Avery, Burke and Caldwell counties for the area, while the tower list places the tower in Caldwell County. The record keeps Caldwell.

notes_for_editor: The 1995 tower evidence rests on a reseller map page whose description reads like generated text; the map's date and the tower label are the only support, so treat it as a lead. The 1922 newspaper items name Big Chestnut Knob; the sources do not say whether that is the summit at the record's coordinates (35.96194, -81.80722). No build date, design, status, or access found. Search snippets included a Facebook group post (not read) and two Wikipedia pages with different elevations for Chestnut Mountain (not used). Two web searches were used for this tower.
